summary: Iteration 12 regression testing PASSED. Frontend: admin login (admin1/admin123) works. Header shows only 'Muat Ulang' + 'Keluar' — global Export Excel button confirmed REMOVED. Kelola User Edit dialog (user-edit-dialog) opens with all 4 role radios including user-edit-role-seller; 'Petugas Penjual Tiket' label present. Masterlist tab shows masterlist-export-umum and masterlist-export-vip buttons per section. Konfirmasi Pesanan dialog shows seats(M21) + Sesi 1 + 'Metode pembayaran: QRIS' and 'Nominal pas + kode unik akan tampil di halaman pembayaran' — NO 'Total Rp X + kode unik' line as required. OrderStatusPage nominal box uses bg-[#F3E9DD] cream background (line 152 & 250) verified via code review.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.js remains ~1960 lines — recommend splitting UsersPanel, MasterlistPanel, VIPPanel, BendaharaPanel to satisfy <700-line guideline.
server.py grew to 1768 lines; consider extracting user management, walkin, bendahara, VIP routers into modules.
GET /api/admin/logs returns raw list without pagination — for long-running events log growth may need TTL/index or pagination.
OrderCreate model uses field 'amount' while UI/tests sometimes conflate 'donation' — consider aliasing for clarity but current behavior is correct.
